Tooltip:
Pattern: RuleBased
Each business rule is evaluated into a named Boolean variable.
A final combine step fires if any rule flag is True.
Inputs / Output: same as IfElse.xaml.

Named rule flags:
  b_Rule_Override           — SecondaryIndicator override
  b_Rule_RG1_Compliant      — RG1: Compliant or empty
  b_Rule_RG1_NonCompliant   — RG1: Non_Compliant + special Attribute_A + low-impact BC
  b_Rule_RG2_IX_Y           — RG2: Indicator_X=Y + acceptable Detail_X
  b_Rule_RG2_IX_N_Compliant — RG2: Indicator_X=N + Compliant or empty
  b_Rule_RG2_IX_N_NonCompliant — RG2: Indicator_X=N + Non_Compliant + attrs
